prompt.project_info: Create a photorealistic 3x3 grid collage of nine dynamic poses by one approved adult woman under a bright sunny sky.
prompt.main_subject: An approved adult woman with consistent natural identity, wearing a light beige knit crop top, high-waisted blue jeans, and delicate gold necklace. Show approachable confident energy across all nine frames.
prompt.composition_elements: 3x3 square grid with varied full-body, close-up, gesture, jumping, turning, laughing, and hair-motion poses against vibrant azure sky and soft clouds.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Harsh high-key natural sunlight with crisp defined shadows, radiant lifestyle campaign mood, consistent face and wardrobe across panels.
prompt.technical_specs: Photorealistic 1:1 collage, 35mm-to-85mm pose variety, high detail, accurate hands and anatomy, consistent adult identity across nine frames.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a photorealistic 1:1 3x3 grid collage of nine dynamic poses by the same approved adult woman under a vibrant azure sky with soft clouds. Keep her light beige knit crop top, high-waisted blue jeans, and delicate gold necklace consistent. Include wide stance, palm toward camera, playful eye gesture, chin in hands, face partly covered, hair twirl, jump, over-shoulder look, and candid laugh. Use crisp natural sunlight, defined shadows, realistic anatomy, and radiant approachable lifestyle mood.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, sexualized framing, erotic pose, minor or child, age ambiguity, celebrity likeness, public-figure likeness, exact face copy, different face across panels, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, over-saturated, airbrushed, HDR look, watermark, extra fingers, malformed grid
